description: Everyday PostgreSQL built-ins type as the engine types them, with no unknown-function warning: a quoted literal passed to a function takes the type of the parameter it is passed to and a numeric value converts to double precision; the regular expression family, hashes, encodings, JSON helpers, settings, advisory locks (routed to the writer), date_bin, the correlation and regression aggregates, bytea overloads and the text[] paths of jsonb_set; JSON set-returning functions and generate_series in a select list; range constructors and bounds; and the enum support functions
